people.imagined: Spring, the grove at the foot of the oldest clump, before dawn. He has just set the censer burning and is standing over it with his hands held out to it like a man warming himself, looking up at the viewer who has come into the grove. He does not hurry.
people.subject: The moment: crouched slightly over a small burning censer at the foot of an ancient bamboo clump before dawn, hands held out to its warmth as if warming himself, he looks up slowly at the viewer who has entered the grove. Face: a broad, slow, calm face, wide cheekbones, a wide flat nose, small kind eyes almost hidden in sun-creases, a grey-streaked short beard, earthy brown skin; streaks of dried grey mud on his cheek and the backs of his hands. Hair: black going grey at the sides, coiled in a knot at the crown and held by a jade bamboo hairpin with a green bamboo-leaf cord. Body: broad, heavy-boned, with a farmer's gentle stoop and thick forearms. Clothing: the sect head's richest robes: layered pale straw-gold bamboo silk with a fine woven grain, three crossed collars embroidered with green bamboo leaves, and over them a long jade-green gauze over-robe embroidered with whole bamboo groves, its wide sleeves drifting; a green silk sash with a jade pendant; a conical hat of split bamboo hangs at his back on a silk cord; his hem and bare shins are still dusted with dried grey mud, which he has not troubled to brush off. Hands and objects: a squat round red-clay censer with a thin lid, glowing ember-orange and trailing a thread of smoke, hung from his belt by a cord and held lightly in both hands; a plaited bamboo-root ring on the little finger of his right hand. Power: a deep, steady aura of green Wood qi rises around him like new leaves, with warm red-gold Fire motes drifting up from the censer and curling among them. Background: pale green bamboo culms in blue pre-dawn mist, one hung with a faint bell-shaped tube. Light: an orange glow from the censer lighting his face from below, cool spirit-light and silver rim light on his shoulders, mist behind. Expression: a slow, calm look up from small eyes buried in sun-creases, a weary patient half-smile and an unhurried stillness.

people.imagined: On the flood terraces at sunrise, a gourd in her hand, she has just looked at the sky and is only now looking at the viewer. Her trousers are rolled to the thigh and she is standing in a flooded paddy with the water at her shins.
people.subject: The moment: standing ankle-deep in a flooded terrace at sunrise, she has been looking up at the sky and now turns to the viewer, a gourd in her hand. Face: a lean, sun-dark, hawk-nosed face, deep-brown skin etched with weather lines, high cheekbones, sharp, patient light-brown eyes with a faint blue-grey ring about the iris, squinting from long sky-watching, a dozen fine lines fanning from each corner; a thin straight mouth with chapped lips; her chin lifted. Hair: black with a broad streak of silver at the front, in a tight knot held by a jade bamboo hairpin, a split-bamboo hat tipped back on its silk cord. Body: lean, wiry, long-limbed, standing with a fisher's wide balance. Clothing: an elder's robes of straw-gold bamboo silk with a green bamboo-leaf collar, three crossed collars, and a jade-green gauze over-robe embroidered with bamboo groves, hitched up and tied back so the hem skims the water; her bare calves and feet are wet and catch a thin line of sunrise gold. Hands and objects: in her right hand a bottle-shaped gourd, mouth up, with nine pale rings marked inside it; in her left a long-handled palm-leaf fan. Power: a cool aura of blue Water qi drifts about her like fine rain, with tiny droplets hanging in the air and a few green Wood motes among them. Background: stepped terraces of silver water mirroring a pink sky, a high thin cloud brushed across it like silk, a stone dyke dividing one terrace that reflects pink from one that stays dark. Light: low golden sunrise from the upper left, shimmering reflections and a soft misty glow. Expression: attentive, stubborn, measuring.

people.imagined: Night in the lower rows. He is standing like a heron beside a seedbed he has warmed with hot kitchen bricks, looking down at three sprouts. He has heard someone come, and has not moved his weight from his one leg.
people.subject: The moment: standing like a heron with his weight on one leg beside a seedbed at night, he looks over his shoulder at the viewer, having heard someone come. Face: a long, quiet, narrow face, a high forehead, a straight nose, mild dark eyes, a faint worry crease between the brows; his fingertips and palms are stained bright leaf-green to the second knuckle on both hands, raised plainly in front of his chest. Hair: black, in a neat knot tied with a green cord and a small jade pin. Body: tall, thin, sloping shoulders, the right foot resting on the left knee. Clothing: the robes of a true disciple of the garden: pale straw-gold bamboo silk with a fine woven grain, two crossed collars embroidered with green bamboo leaves, wide sleeves falling in soft folds, a dark-green silk sash with a small jade pendant; the hem touches only a little mud. Hands and objects: in his lowered hand a warm kitchen brick wrapped in cloth; at his feet a row of dark earth with three small, bright green sprouts; a small curved seed knife in a sheath at his belt. Power: a faint green glow of Wood qi gathers round the three sprouts and the stained hands, with a few pale green motes lifting in the warmth. Background: dark fields, a low bamboo fence and stakes tagged with scraps of cloth marking the seedbeds, and a hut with one lantern far off. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left, a deep blue night and a soft moonlit mist over the beds. Expression: humble, diffident, hopeful.

people.imagined: On the rat plain at dusk, a rat-skin cloak over his shoulders. He has just counted a run of burrows and written nothing down; a bamboo rat the size of a dog watches him from his feet. He is calculating what the sack is worth.
people.subject: The moment: crouched on the rat plain at dusk beside a large bamboo rat, he looks up at the viewer with a sly squint, calculating what the sack is worth. Face: the tip of his nose is plainly missing, bitten off flat and scarred, a blunt healed stub with two wide nostrils; round it a wiry, narrow, ratty face, small close-set eyes, sparse stubble, big ears, a slack mouth with crooked teeth. Hair: coarse black, in a stiff short tail bound with a green cord. Body: wiry, hunched, quick. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of straw-gold bamboo silk with green bamboo-leaf embroidery at the crossed collars, belted with a dark green sash; over his shoulders a cloak sewn from well-matched grey-brown rat skins, which the story calls for, cleanly cut and worn like a trophy; silver-grey bracers on his wrists; a conical split-bamboo hat hung at his back on its silk cord. Hands and objects: in his left hand a sack of coarse hemp; his right rests on the head of a fat brown bamboo rat the size of a dog, whiskers and large yellow front teeth showing. Power: a thin green thread of Wood qi runs along his fingers, with a few cold grey-silver motes of Metal at his bracers. Background: a dry plain at dusk with burrow mounds and thin bamboo, a tall post with a dried rat-skin nailed to it, and a plume of dust from a distant herd rising in violet haze. Light: low orange dusk from the upper left, with a soft cool rim light along his shoulder and a hazy glow. Expression: shifty, greedy, secretive.

people.imagined: The granary gate at Hoàng Vân Thành, autumn, the seed carts behind her. She has just said the right thing to the right person and is laughing lightly; a bowl of steaming rice is on a barrel beside her.
people.subject: The moment: at a granary gate in autumn, she laughs lightly and tilts her head toward the viewer as if sharing a secret, having just said the right thing to the right person. Face: a warm, comely oval face, smooth rosy cheeks and a dimple, a small neat nose, bright, quick dark eyes with lowered lashes, a ready rounded smile; a tiny beauty spot under her left eye. Hair: glossy black, in an elaborate high knot with a blue silk band and a pair of silver pins and a tiny jade bamboo-leaf ornament. Body: slim, poised, standing with her weight on one hip and her shoulders turned toward the viewer, an open, inviting posture. Clothing: layered robes of pale straw-gold bamboo silk, two crossed collars embroidered with green bamboo leaves, a blue silk gauze over-robe with wide sleeves, a sash hung with a jade pendant and a blue tassel; a small split-bamboo hat tied behind her with a blue ribbon. Hands and objects: in her right hand a bowl of white rice, steaming; her left rests lightly on a sack of seed. Power: a soft green aura of Wood qi hangs about her shoulders like spring light, with a few pale blue Water motes sparkling at her sleeves. Background: a granary gate with grain sacks and a cart, farm carts with high wooden wheels in a line behind her, a heap of seed sacks tied with green cord, the tiled granary roof and a dim crowd at its gate, all in golden haze. Light: warm golden afternoon light from the upper left, glowing mist and a soft rim light on her hair. Expression: charming, bright and calculating.

people.imagined: He is in the lower rows at midday, holding court for a visitor, his chin lifted as he says his daughter's name. A brass ring of keys jingles at his belt.
people.subject: The moment: standing proudly in the lower rows at midday, chin lifted high, he holds court for a visitor as he says his daughter's name. Face: the chin raised so high that its underside shows, a proud jutting double chin above a round, red, good-natured face, plump cheeks, a short wide nose, small eager brown eyes, a thin moustache waxed to two fine points, a small wart beside his nose, burst veins on the cheeks of a man who eats well; he is beaming. Hair: thin grey, scraped back under a small gold-green silk cap with a jade clasp, the band leaving a faint ring in the hair. Body: stout, with a rounded belly, shoulders back. Clothing: a steward's robes of straw-gold bamboo silk, well-fitted, with two crossed collars embroidered in green bamboo leaves, a short cape of woven green-gold silk straw-work, and a narrow green sash; the hem freshly brushed above a little mud at the knee. Hands and objects: a large brass ring of many keys hangs at his belt and glints; his right hand points a finger upward as if making a point; a seed knife in its sheath. Power: a faint green shimmer of Wood qi lies on his shoulders, barely there. Background: the lower rows running away in neat lines, every bamboo clump tagged with a strip of red cloth, a heap of cut culms ready for the cart, and a small hut with a locked door, in soft bright mist. Light: bright warm noon sun from the upper left, softened by drifting haze and a gentle glow. Expression: chin thrust up, round red cheeks plump and shining, small eager eyes bright with pride and a gullible, pleased smile.

people.imagined: At the sluice at dawn, a key in her hand, she is explaining a measure to someone and is just stumbling on a word. She presses her tongue against her teeth, frowns, and says it anyway.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a sluice gate at dawn, she speaks, her lips parted and the tip of her tongue visible between her teeth on a sibilant, frowning with stubborn effort. Face: a brass sluice key hangs on a cord at her neck and swings bright in front of her chest; a long, serious scholar's face, a straight narrow nose, ink-black brows, clear steady dark eyes behind a slight frown, fair skin lightly tanned. Hair: black, in a tidy double loop tied with a green cord and a jade bamboo pin. Body: slender, straight, a teacher's posture. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of pale straw-gold bamboo silk, three crossed collars embroidered with green bamboo leaves, wide sleeves tied back with silk cord, a long indigo gauze skirt, its hem wet and darkened by the sluice water; a conical split-bamboo hat hanging at her back. Hands and objects: a scroll-like measuring rod of pale bamboo marked with rings in her left hand; a sluice wheel behind her. Power: a few blue Water motes float about the key and her wet hem, a cool aura around her sleeves. Background: a stone sluice with water running out, a row of marked bamboo rods standing in the water and a small board with a scale of notches nailed to the post, in dawn mist. Light: cool clear dawn light from the upper left, a silver glow on the water and a soft rim light on her cheek. Expression: a serious frown of stubborn effort with lips parted round the hard sound, steady eyes fixed and honest.

people.imagined: Walking the fence at night, he has stopped, hand extended, because he has heard something under the brook. His eyes, wide open even in the lantern light, are fixed on a tunnel mouth.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a fence, lantern raised, he stares with huge unblinking eyes at the viewer or just past them, having heard something under the brook. Face: very wide-open eyes, whites visible around the iris, never blinking, a sleepless, haunted stare; a lean, long, sallow face, sunken cheeks, black stubble, a hooked nose, bluish shadows under the eyes; thin dark brows arched high so that he seems permanently startled; a single bead of sweat runs down his temple despite the cold. Hair: black and greasy, in a short loose knot with a plain dark-green cord. Body: tall, stooped, thin, shoulders drawn up toward his ears and head slightly forward, the stance of a man who listens more than he speaks. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of pale straw-gold bamboo silk, its crossed collars embroidered with small green bamboo leaves, a dark oiled gauze cloak over it, a split-bamboo hat hung at his back on its silk cord; a little mud at the knee. Hands and objects: across the back of the left hand, which holds the lantern high, a pale jagged rat-bite scar, plainly visible; his right hand holds a short wooden spike. Power: a faint grey-green Wood qi flickers at his eyes and fingertips like a held breath. Background: a line of sharpened bamboo stakes lashed with cord running away behind him, and a dark patch of broken earth where a tunnel mouth opens beneath the brook bank, in night mist. Light: yellow lantern light from the upper left casting hard shadows upward over his face so his eyes look like two white discs, deep blue-black night with a thin silver moon glow behind. Expression: sleepless, wary, shut.

people.imagined: On the tribute road, asleep on the cart with the ox picking the way. He has woken to count the carts and lost the count at four, humming. He grins at the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: sprawled on a seed cart on the tribute road, he counts on his fingers and grins at the viewer, having just lost the count at four. Face: a wide, open, sunburnt face with big rosy cheeks, a snub nose, a loose goofy grin with a gap between the front teeth, crinkled and slightly glazed eyes, a forehead lined with effort; a dribble of sleepy drool dried at the corner of his mouth and the weave-marks of a sack on his cheek. Hair: brown, shaggy, a bamboo leaf stuck in it, under a crooked split-bamboo hat on a silk cord. Body: big, loose, comfortable. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple robe of straw-gold bamboo silk, rumpled, with a green bamboo-leaf border at the crossed collar and one loose button, a plain green sash, wide silk trousers, straw sandals worn through at the toe; a bamboo-leaf wrapper of rice cake sticks out of his breast, and a seed knife hangs at his hip. Hands and objects: the left hand held up with four fingers counted down, the thumb tucked; the right holds the ox's slack rope; beside him sacks of pale seed. Background: a broad brown ox plodding ahead with its head low, the wooden wheels, sacks piled like pillows, and a long yellow road lined with bamboo under a wide sky, in a warm haze. Light: warm afternoon light from the upper left gilding the dust raised by the wheels, with a soft glow and gentle rim light. Expression: a loose, gap-toothed grin with crinkled glazed eyes and rosy cheeks, happily lazy and without a worry.

people.imagined: Walking behind her master with his satchel of knives clinking, she has stopped to hold up her fingertips to the light and see whether the soot has spread. She hopes it has.
people.subject: The moment: pausing mid-step on a path behind her master, she raises her right hand and inspects her fingertips in the light, hopeful and anxious, to see whether the soot has spread. Face: a narrow, earnest, pale face, a straight nose, level brows, long straight lashes, steady dark eyes, a firm mouth with a pinch of worry between the brows; the fingertips of both hands are black with soot, clearly dark against pale skin as if dipped in ink, and a faint soot smudge sits on her chin. Hair: black, in a single braid pinned up and tied with a green cord, one stray lock against her cheek. Body: slim, upright, a little stiff with duty. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an inner disciple, a straw-gold bamboo-silk jacket and long skirt with green bamboo-leaf embroidery at the crossed collars, a green silk sash with a small jade pendant; her left sleeve is clean, her boots dusted with mud at the ankle. Hands and objects: a canvas satchel at her left hip bulging with the wood and bone handles of harvest knives, its strap in her left hand. Power: a tiny spark of red Fire glows at her blackened fingertips, with a few pale green Wood motes drifting near. Background: a packed earth path between two clumps of tall green bamboo whose culms rise out of the frame, a stone marker half in shadow, in drifting mist. Light: warm morning light from the upper left, dappled green-gold through leaves, glinting on the satchel buckle. Expression: a hopeful, anxious look at her fingertips, brows drawn together, steady dark eyes wide and the lips pressed thin.

people.imagined: On the terraces at evening, back at the sluices after being sent down. She stops and looks at the horizon where there is no sea, as she often does, and is only slightly sad about it.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a terrace at evening, she squints past the viewer at the horizon, one hand shading her eyes, looking for a sea that is not there. Face: a squint of long habit, eyes narrowed to slits and a line between the brows, as if reading the open sea; a round, brown, sun-freckled face, a wide mouth with parted lips, strong cheeks, cheeks and nose peeling from the sun, a few fine strands stuck to a salty forehead; her bare heels show pale salt cracks. Hair: black, in a thick braid with a salt-bleached tip, strands bleached rust-brown by the sun, a small green silk ribbon. Body: sturdy, short, with strong calves. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple silk, a short straw-gold bamboo-silk jacket with a green bamboo-leaf collar and trousers rolled to the knee, a blue silk cord belt; the hem splashed with water. Hands and objects: a bamboo sluice pole over her shoulder; her bare feet in shallow water. Power: a few pale blue Water motes shimmer by her hand, a faint cool mist at her ankles. Background: terraces glimmering at dusk in curving mirror bands, a bamboo sluice gate half open, and beyond them the empty horizon of haze. Light: low orange evening light from the upper left turning the water to a sheet of copper, with a soft glow and mist. Expression: a narrowed, far squint toward the empty horizon, a soft content mouth with a faint homesick droop at the corners.

people.imagined: At the end of a furrow with the ox beside him, leaning on the plough handle to take weight off his bad leg. A clod of mud has dried in his ear and he has not noticed.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a plough handle at the end of a furrow, with the ox beside him, he looks at the viewer with a slow, humble smile, weight off his bad leg. Face: a lump of grey dried mud plainly caked in his left ear; a broad, brown, weather-beaten, lined face, a wide flat nose, small kind eyes of soft warm brown with yellowed whites, grey stubble, a missing side tooth, his mouth slightly open. Hair: grey-black, close-cropped, under a wide plain straw hat with straw sticking from the brim. Body: thickset, stooped, the right leg held a little off the ground with a limp. Clothing: a servant's plain, clean but old tunic and trousers of pale undyed silk-hemp, mended at both knees, a rope belt with a wooden pipe tucked in; he is a mortal servant of the garden, so it is plain and clean, with no sect embroidery but a faint straw-gold tint; mud to the thighs, bare feet caked black to the ankle. Hands and objects: both hands grip the wooden plough handle; behind him a brown ox. Power: none; only the soft glow of the evening on him. Background: fresh dark furrows running to the foot of a low hill, a few pale clumps of bamboo along the field edge, a flock of small brown birds picking at the turned earth, all in drifting mist. Light: soft pearly spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle glow making the mud shine, with silver mist behind. Expression: a slow, humble smile, small kind eyes crinkled and the weathered face honest and unhurried.

people.imagined: Resting at a clump of bamboo in the late afternoon beside a notched culm, with a milky eye turned toward it. He has just run his thumb over the notch and is quietly sure of something.
people.subject: The moment: crouching by an old bamboo culm in the late afternoon, he touches a notch cut in it with one thumb and turns his face to the viewer, quietly sure of something. Face: one eye plainly milky white and clouded, a blind blue-white pupil, the other dark and sharp; a deeply lined, old, brown face, a thin sparse white beard, a bent nose; the hand beside it shows a plough-handle callus as big as an egg at the base of the thumb. Hair: white and wispy, tied in a thin knot under a wide plain straw hat with a tidy cord. Body: bent, wiry, old, crouching easily on his heels with both knees up and one hand braced on the ground. Clothing: a mortal servant's tunic of plain pale undyed silk-hemp, clean and mended, a rope belt, trousers rolled to the calf, plain and tidy with no sect embroidery; mud to the knee. Hands and objects: the huge callus on the right palm; a small knife in the left. Power: none; a faint gold glow lies on the notch under his thumb. Background: an old clump of tall bamboo, its culms thick as a man's arm and the greenish-gold of old jade; on one culm at head height a neat square notch scored with a knife, and a second notch in the next, in soft mist. Light: low gold spirit-light from the upper left showing every line and hair of his face, the milky eye glowing pale, a gentle rim glow. Expression: one clouded white eye and one sharp dark one turned to the viewer, a mild, content mouth and a quiet certainty in the old face.

people.imagined: Greeting a traveller at the edge of the lower rows. He pats his belly as he always does before a question, the ledger pencil behind his ear, and asks: does your bamboo seed every year?
people.subject: The moment: standing at the edge of the lower rows, patting his round belly with one hand before asking a traveller a question, cheerful and curious. Face: a long ledger pencil tucked behind his left ear, plainly visible; a round, friendly face, plump pink cheeks, a snub nose, a freckled nose, bright curious eyes, a quick smile with a small chipped front tooth, a fine fuzz of beard on the chin. Hair: brown, short, a little sticking up under a split-bamboo hat with a green silk bow. Body: soft, round-bellied, feet apart, leaning back slightly with his belly forward. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple robe of pale straw-gold bamboo silk, a little tight across the stomach, with green bamboo-leaf embroidery at its crossed collar, a silk belt with a jade-bead tassel, a small purse and a ring of two keys. Hands and objects: his right palm on his belly, a small notebook of cut bamboo slats in the left. Background: pale-green bamboo shoots in long straight rows with a wooden marker at the head of each, a wheelbarrow, and a road leading to distant farm buildings in morning mist. Light: bright clear morning light from the upper left making the shoots almost luminous, with soft glow and gentle rim light. Expression: a keen, friendly gleam in the look and a ready grin, as if the answer would please him either way.

people.imagined: In a purple bamboo forest, mid-step, he has frozen to listen. A sound only he hears; his face turns slowly toward it, moss-green sleeves hanging.
people.subject: The moment: frozen mid-step in a forest of purple-black bamboo, head tilted, one hand cupped behind his ear, he listens to something behind the viewer that only he hears. Face: a gentle, narrow, pale face, a long straight nose, large dark eyes wide and distant, lips just parted and dry; a thin pale scar through his left eyebrow and a drop of dew on his lashes. Hair: dark brown, loose on the shoulders, a dry bamboo leaf caught in it, a thin jade bamboo ribbon-pin at the crown. Body: tall, thin, one foot lifted, arms held a little away from his body. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of pale straw-gold bamboo silk with two crossed collars of green bamboo-leaf embroidery, the wide lower sleeves stained deep moss-green from wrist to elbow, soft with damp, a plain green sash with a small jade pendant; soft boots wet to the ankle with dew; a small hoe on his back and a bundle of green weeding hooks at his belt. Hands and objects: one hand cupped behind his ear, the other holding the sleeve out. Power: a faint green Wood glow in his sleeves and a few blue Water motes like dew drifting by his shoulders. Background: tall purple-black bamboo on every side, glossy as lacquer, a green gloom beneath, a narrow path covered with fallen leaves and a hint of a hidden clearing, in mist. Light: dim green-violet spirit-light from the upper left falling in thin shafts between the leaves, gleaming on the mossy sleeves. Expression: head tilted and eyes wide and far away, lips just parted, his gentle face frozen in rapt, silent listening.

people.imagined: At the harvest rows, shoving a slower hand off her row. She does not look at the girl; she looks forward, pulling a seed head, her ponytail so tight it lifts her brows.
people.subject: The moment: working a harvest row at speed, she looks sharply sideways at the viewer as if they were in her way, having just shoved a slower hand off her row. Face: a ponytail pulled so tight it lifts her eyebrows high and stretches the corners of her eyes upward, a permanent look of surprise; two deep zither-string grooves cut across both index fingers raised at her chest; a narrow, sharp face, a thin pointed nose, hard bright eyes, a tight mouth, a harsh pink flush from the work, a small scab on her chin. Hair: black, in a high ponytail bound with a green silk cord. Body: wiry, forward-leaning. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple silk, a pale straw-gold bamboo-silk jacket with green bamboo-leaf collar embroidery, sleeves tied back, a green silk sash knotted twice, a short skirt over trousers; the left sleeve re-sewn at the seam in white thread; mud to the knee; a small leather case of spare knives over one shoulder. Hands and objects: a curved seed knife in her right hand, a basket of seed heads on her hip. Power: a thin line of green Wood qi sparkles along the knife blade. Background: harvest rows running to the horizon, each with a worker bent to it, loaded baskets in the aisle and a banner of plain green silk on a pole, in thin mist. Light: hard bright morning light from the upper left throwing sharp shadows of tall culms across her face, with a clean silver rim. Expression: a sharp sideways glare, the lifted brows and stretched eyes hard, the mouth tight and impatient with the slower hand.

people.imagined: At the sluice in full sun, she is drawing a rope up. The sun has turned her brick red and the old rope scars at both wrists are white.
people.subject: The moment: hauling a sluice rope in bright sun, she looks calmly at the viewer. Face: deeply sunburnt, brick-red skin on the face and neck, and thin white rope scars ringing both wrists, bright against the red; a broad, calm face, strong cheekbones, narrow dark eyes with deep laugh lines at the corners, a straight nose, a content small smile, a cracked lower lip, a peeling nose showing pale. Hair: black, in a plain bun under a split-bamboo hat on a silk cord, a few stray hairs stuck to her damp forehead. Body: stocky, strong-armed. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple silk, a straw-gold bamboo-silk jacket with green bamboo-leaf borders, sleeves rolled to the elbow and stained with water to the chest, gauze trousers rolled to the knee, a blue silk cord belt holding a small knife and a bundle of spare rope; her bare feet planted wide on the wooden platform. Hands and objects: both hands gripping a sluice rope pale with water; a wooden sluice gate dripping behind her. Power: blue Water motes and a faint cool mist rise off the rope where she grips it. Background: a dripping wooden sluice with a heavy winch, a wide terrace of green rice, a channel pouring down in a bright sheet, a pale heron on the dyke, in haze. Light: strong white sun from the upper left, dazzling reflections from the water onto her chin and hat brim, softened by spirit-mist. Expression: easy and unworried, with the plain candour of someone who has nothing to hide from the sun or the viewer.

people.imagined: On the rat plain at dusk, setting a snare. She does not look up; her stare never leaves the trap. When she does look up at the viewer, it is flat and appraising.
people.subject: The moment: crouched over a snare on the rat plain at dusk, she looks up at the viewer with a flat, steady stare, her eyes having never left the trap until now. Face: a thin, sharp, narrow face, a small mouth with thin lips set in a hard line, cold unblinking grey eyes; pale raised rat-bite scars in several rows up the whole length of her right forearm, held across her knee, plainly visible. Hair: black, in a tight short braid, short stray hairs escaped round her ears and brow. Body: small, wiry, crouched on the balls of her feet with her elbows on her knees, absolutely still, the stance of one who can wait all night. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple silk, a straw-gold bamboo-silk jacket with green bamboo-leaf collar embroidery, sleeves rolled above the elbows, a dark grey sash, and fur-lined soft boots; no apron. Hands and objects: a loop of twisted cord, a wooden stake; a snare on the ground. Power: a faint grey-green shimmer of Wood and Metal qi clings to the cord and her scarred forearm. Background: a long line of fence posts, each topped by a small dark shape, across a flat dry plain pocked with burrow mounds, a thin grey line of bamboo on the horizon, in cold mist. Light: low cold orange dusk from the upper left outlining the snare cord and every pale scar, with a silver rim light. Expression: an appraising stillness with no warmth at all; she weighs the viewer as she would prey.

people.imagined: 760, the wet grass below the purple bamboo, he has led forty unkindled disciples down and stands before a first clump of seed bamboo, hands held out toward it, asking for it.
people.subject: The moment: in 760, standing in wet grass below the purple bamboo before a first young clump of seed bamboo, he holds out both open hands to it as if asking, having led forty unkindled disciples down. Face: a gentle, patient, lined, long peach-farmer's face, a thin grey beard, thin white brows, soft brown eyes, a mild open mouth with chapped lips, deep crow's-feet; his right palm shows a pale burn scar and the back of his right hand a thin white scar from a hundred failed feathers. Hair: white, in a thin knot held by a plain jade bamboo hairpin, a few straggling hairs across his forehead, a plain straw hat. Body: tall, thin, stooped, peasant-lean, shoulders rounded and knees a little bent as if ready to kneel before a test. Clothing: the founder's robe of soft green-grey bamboo silk cut long, with straw-gold under-collars, a jade-green gauze over-robe embroidered with bamboo groves, a plain green cord at the waist, a plain cape of woven straw-silk; his feet bare in the wet grass. Hands and objects: a peach branch in his left hand. Power: a gentle green Wood aura glows round his open hands and the young clump, faint motes rising. Background: behind him forty small figures in plain robes wait in a loose group on the wet grass, a line of purple bamboo at the clearing's edge and a low grey sky. Light: soft grey-green spirit-light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: a mild, open mouth and soft brown eyes lifted toward the clump, patient and humble, his face tender as in prayer.

people.imagined: The spring of 1050 among the flowering bamboo. She has walked out into it with her sleeves loose and stands among the pale blossoms with her eyes closed; the rat-bitten hands are held out to her.
people.subject: The moment: in the spring of 1050 she stands in a grove of flowering bamboo with her eyes closed and her arms lowered, calm, her sleeves loose. Face: a calm, long, pale oval face with closed eyes and a faint serene smile, a high forehead, a long thin nose, a firm chin, fine lines at the corners of her closed eyes, pale lips slightly parted as though breathing in the scent; pale yellow-green blossoms caught in her hair; on her left hand faint pale marks of old rat bites. Hair: grey-white, long and loose to the waist, a bamboo flower behind the ear and a jade bamboo hairpin at the crown. Body: tall, thin, straight, shoulders relaxed, light as a reed, leaning a little toward the grove. Clothing: the robes of a head of the garden: long layered straw-gold bamboo silk, three crossed collars embroidered with green bamboo leaves, a jade-green gauze over-robe with wide trailing sleeves embroidered with bamboo groves, a green silk sash and a thin green cord of woven bamboo fibre looped round her neck; the hem is spotted with yellow pollen. Hands and objects: palms open, dusted with pale petals. Power: a soft green aura of Wood qi swirls round her with drifting pale pollen-motes. Background: tall bamboo clumps covered in fine drooping blossoms of pale yellow-green, a dust of pollen hanging in the light, small brown rats creeping unseen among the roots. Light: soft green-gold spirit-light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: closed eyes and a faint, serene smile on the long pale face, the brow smooth and a stillness like a held breath.
